_comment: Template documenting the JSON Claude returns from /ml-review (introduced 2026-05-26; two-layer CHECKS + ANALYSIS shape 2026-10-28, see .claude/skills/ml-review/SKILL.md). Carries the shared pattern's four blocks (prior_calls_scorecard, checks C1-C9, analysis, calls; docs/reference/llm-analyst-skill-design.md) plus promotion/demotion proposals against the 3-stage ladder (candidate -> shadow -> advisory) and experiment proposals. This skill never edits ml/configs/ — proposals only. This file is documentation, not a validated JSON Schema.

prior_calls_scorecard._comment: Layer 0 (pattern docs/reference/llm-analyst-skill-design.md § 6): the previous ml-review record's calls[] graded by re-running each call's own check. Older records without calls[] grade promotion_recommendations[] / next_by_value_per_cost[] / 're-read next week' lines and say so. brier is INDETERMINATE below 10 resolved calls.

calls.action_happened: yes | no — <why, and re-filed as / killed because>

checks._comment: Layer 1 CHECKS C1..C9 (SKILL.md table). Each entry: state ok | finding | could-not-look, numbers (windows lifetime/90d/30d/7d where they apply), population, locator. Numbers only; no interpretation here. A missing instrument is 'could-not-look: no instrument' + the row that builds it.

C1_trainer_registry.locator: relay issue / endpoint / script + exit code

C2_freshness.locator: relay issue / endpoint / script + exit code

C3_business_use.locator: relay issue / endpoint / script + exit code

C4_learning_chain.locator: relay issue / endpoint / script + exit code

C5_serve_parity.locator: relay issue / endpoint / script + exit code

C6_champion_challenger.locator: relay issue / endpoint / script + exit code

C7_drift_split.locator: relay issue / endpoint / script + exit code

C8_concentration.locator: relay issue / endpoint / script + exit code

C9_research_backlog.locator: relay issue / endpoint / script + exit code

analysis._comment: Layer 2 ANALYSIS: Claude's reasoning (pattern § 3). 3-7 material questions ranked by money/decision impact; each with competing hypotheses (noise always one), the test run, and what survived. Prose first (the markdown), then copied here.

hypotheses.name: noise | regime_mix | capability_loss | wiring | data_limit | underpowered | measurement | <other>
hypotheses.predicts: <what it predicts that the others do not>

calls._comment: Layer 3: every decision this review makes, ranked by impact. The NEXT review's Layer 0 re-runs check.command and applies check.rule as written.
calls.ending: <checklist row | queue unit | PI id | promotion_recommendations[i] | no action, because ...>

trainer_models.note: per-model roll-up; concern only when an advisory+/live model degrades on live/shadow data

model_status._comment: Only models at shadow/advisory and any model a consumer reads (C3). Every other registered model is one count line in model_status_summary. [] only when the trainer relay errored (then checks.C1 = could-not-look).
model_status.stage: candidate | shadow | advisory (canonical 3-stage; normalize legacy names via ml.manifest.canonical_stage)

live_shadow.score_summary: score distribution / mean when predictions>0, else 'no predictions yet'
live_shadow.realized: win-rate / PnL of closed trades this model scored, when joinable; else 'n/a'

model_status.note: <= 160 chars — one-line health verdict for this model

model_status_summary: e.g. '73 candidate models (gbdt 60, ...): train nightly, no consumer'

promotion_recommendations._comment: Tier-3 stage moves (or data-backed per canonical § Data-backed Tier-2/3 decisions). shadow->advisory is THE live-trading gate; demotions are Tier-3 too. Cite the gate-check packet AND the C3 decision value.
promotion_recommendations.evidence: <= 240 chars — N predictions, win-rate on joined trades, drift verdict, training trend
promotion_recommendations.risk_note: <= 160 chars — what to watch after applying, kill-switch path

experiments_proposed._comment: Forward-looking ML coverage expansion. Each proposal is an idea the operator can convert to a manifest / feature / dataset / target / sweep.
experiments_proposed.name: <short slug>
experiments_proposed.expected_metric_signal: <what would convince us this is worth shadowing>
experiments_proposed.next_step: PR a new ml/configs/<name>.yaml | extend ml/features/... | new dataset family in src/ml/datasets/...

backlog_drain._comment: One entry per open ML row in docs/claude/work/pipeline/ (population: skill § Backlog drain). action: resolved | fixed_now | invalid | kept_open.

anomalies: free-form list of notable items (datasets failing, runs erroring, predictions silently dropping, etc.)

claude_channel_ping._comment: The one-line update posted to @claude_ict_comms_bot via the send-ping system-action.
